## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Fork changes target `main` in
`dbbaskette/superpowers-custom`; upstream contributions require separate authorization.

## Verification

Record the tested source state, checks and outcomes, and any relevant limitations.
For behavior changes, distinguish scenario evidence from packaging or script checks.
Do not claim human review, model evaluation, or platform coverage that did not occur.

## Release

When applicable, include the custom version, installation target, and rollback artifact.
